## **Practical exercises**:

-  Visualize [Indice de Probreza Multidimensional (IPM)](https://dane.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=6107cbd52ebe400ba76be80bce7b3b29#overview) by DANE(2020)

-  Add a new ArcGIS REST Server Layer using [this URL](https://services1.arcgis.com/I4YYbPSw13ugmbAP/arcgis/rest/services/IPM_simp_gdb/FeatureServer)

-  Export the layers to a geopackage file

-  Select the IPM layers corresponding to your department and export to *IPM_DeptoX.gpkg*

-  Add municipalities, population, roads, cities, and IPM layers to a new QGIS project

-  Define symbology for each layer (add labels as needed)

-  Make a map of IPM and colour print it 

**Make sure you bring the IPM map to the classroom on 8th October**
